name: com.wgs.sdk.activity.RewardVideoAdActivity
description: The CashCat SDK from CashCat22 and BXM SDK from Sinnerlwu both include this WGS rewarded-ad page. It plays a video ad and opens the ad's end page after playback completes.
disableEffect: Rewarded video ads will not play, and rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.
